about_text:
NoJunk
Delete enemy drops precisely. Writes are guarded by version fingerprint, conflict check, auto-backup and atomic write.
All data is parsed live from your own game files.
prob_prompt:
Set drop rate for "%s" to (%%):
(0 = delete, 100 = guaranteed; other drops in the same table shrink proportionally)
boost_done: Boosted: %d items, %d slots set to full weight
boost_infeasible: Skipped %d table(s): these tables can't fit the rates you set (either your targets add up to more than 100%%, or items that always drop already take up all the room). In the first case, lower one of your targets. In the second, lowering won't help — delete those always-dropping items instead (usually just one is enough). Note: those items drop guaranteed in the vanilla game; once deleted, they will no longer be guaranteed. Rates for those tables were not written (all other changes were applied).
boost_infeasible_sole: Skipped %d table(s): in these tables the item is already the only drop, so it always drops (rate is fixed at 100%%) and cannot be lowered — this is not a mistake in what you entered. To see it less often, tick it for deletion; lowering the rate cannot do that.
boost_infeasible_over: Skipped %d table(s): these tables can't fit the rate you set — items that always drop already take up all the room, so lowering your target won't help. Delete those always-dropping items instead (usually just one is enough). Note: those items drop guaranteed in the vanilla game; once deleted, they will no longer be guaranteed.
boost_infeasible_sum: Skipped %d table(s): the rates you set in these tables add up to more than 100%%, so they don't fit. Lower one of them (if items that always drop are also mentioned, do both).
boost_no_toggle: %s is boosted; clear its boost in Global first
legend: Click to cycle: ☐ keep → ☑ delete → ⊠ protect this enemy

game_changed_warn:
The game files differ from this version of NoJunk2 (actual size: %d).
The game was probably just updated. Writing anyway carries some risk, but every change is backed up and Restore vanilla is always available.

Continue anyway?
drop_external_warn: This item comes from gifts/stealing/chests, not kill drops - it cannot be removed per-enemy.
preview_shared_warn: ⚠ %d slot(s) are in SHARED tables used by many enemies - clearing them affects everyone sharing those tables.
nondrop_include_on: Scope widened: drops from sources other than enemies (purchase/promo rewards, affinity gift returns, trade) will now be changed too.
nondrop_include_off: Scope restored: only enemy kill drops are changed — purchase/promo rewards, affinity gift returns and trade are left untouched.
nondrop_confirm:
This will change %d drop slot(s) that do NOT come from killing enemies.

Those are purchase/promo rewards, affinity gift returns or trade items — not monster junk. Changing them does not make your farming cleaner, it removes content.

Continue anyway?
stale_head: Some of your saved selections no longer match the game data, so they will do nothing.
stale_groups: • %d of %d enemy groups can no longer be found (IDs changed)
stale_items: • %d item selections no longer exist in their drop tables
stale_why_old: Most likely cause: this settings file was written by a different version of NoJunk2.
stale_why_data: Most likely cause: the game was updated, or the bundled mapping data is out of date.
stale_fix: Please re-select those drops in the list. If this keeps happening, delete nojunk2.json and _game_cache.pkl next to the exe and let the tool rebuild them.
rebuild_confirm:
Rebuild the enemy-to-droptable mapping from the current game files?

Use this after a game update: without it, enemies may show as "no drop table" and your saved selections will stop working.

The current mapping will be backed up first. This takes tens of seconds.
rebuild_fail: Rebuild failed — the old mapping was left untouched.
rebuild_result:
Rebuild complete.

Drop tables: %d
Existing enemies kept: %d
New enemies inferred: %d
Total in mapping: %d
rebuild_reload: Please click Load again so the new mapping takes effect.
undo_confirm:
Undo the last apply?

This restores the state from just before your most recent apply.
undo_none: No backup found — nothing to undo.
undo_done: Undone — restored the state before your last apply.
game_updated_hint:
Game files changed since your last run.

If enemies show as "no drop table", click Rebuild mapping.
drop_uncal_warn: This enemy's drop table is inferred and unverified - cannot be modified.

ov_stale_content:
The patch on disk is outdated.
